configuration.modifier_interpretation: One catchall annual probability max(base tenure/nationality/category rate, conditional age-retention hazard) in all five EB categories; no independent mortality draw or legacy age floor.
configuration.sample_size_rule: Fixed counts declared before execution. Report attained MCSE; do not stop early or extend opportunistically to meet it.
configuration.sensitivity_budget_rationale: Fifty paired replications support the primary means and subgroup summaries. Ten paired replications per alternative age schedule characterize structural sensitivity. Ten historical replay pairs support matched comparisons, with the sample size fixed before execution. Its attained Monte Carlo precision is reported for matched changes. The two long-follow-up pairs remain a separate diagnostic. All cases are rerun under the common age schedule for EB-1 through EB-5.
configuration.uncertainty_scope: Student-t intervals describe numerical uncertainty in fixed-input simulation means. Age schedules and historical replay are separate sensitivity experiments, not probability bounds.
